name: Connect my existing private GitHub repository

messages.content:
Connect my existing private GitHub repository to this cloud workspace.

Repository: soulahmd/jarvis-ai-assistant
Branch: main

I want to continue working on my existing JARVIS project, not create a new project.

Please:

1. Import/clone the existing repository.
2. Preserve the current code and project structure.
3. Do not initialize a new project.
4. Do not overwrite or delete existing files.
5. Confirm when the repository is connected and show the project files.
